insight: Iraq's performance during hydration breaks in the 2026 World Cup shows that the team tends to gain momentum after these breaks, with a slight overall positive change in their performance. However, when Iraq was pressing before a hydration break, they actually lost momentum, with their performance declining by an average of 0.300 minutes, and they were unable to regain it after the break. In contrast, when Iraq was not pressing before a break, they were able to maintain or slightly improve their performance, with a small average gain of 0.075 minutes, suggesting that the breaks may have given them a chance to regroup and refocus. This suggests that Iraq may need to adjust their strategy when pressing before a hydration break to avoid losing momentum and instead use the break to their advantage.
